item.title: Reading a Quantum Dot's Buried Architecture
item.description: A three-dimensional atomic reconstruction reveals a lopsided core and uneven shell inside a single quantum dot, with nearly atomically abrupt internal seams.

item.title: The AI Learning Chemical Intuition from Spectra Alone
item.description: In a multi-agent loop, an AI proposes molecular structures from raw spectra, revises them against simulated data, and learns ring-first chemical intuition.

item.title: How Ocean Fronts Regulate the Hidden Energy Cascade
item.description: Submesoscale ocean fronts act as key regulators, transferring kinetic energy both upward into giant eddies and downward toward dissipation in the Agulhas Current.

item.title: Collective Blinking: One Quencher, a Thousand Darkened Ions
item.description: A single transient quencher can short-circuit the shared energy migration network of a lanthanide-doped nanocrystal, causing thousands of ions to blink on and off in perfect synchrony.

item.title: How Brain Static Learns to Dance
item.description: Non-invasive EEG signals, resembling faint brain static, are translated into continuous full-body dance motions by a generative model, expanding the vocabulary of brain-computer interfaces.

item.title: The AI Layoff Trap That Outruns Cooperation
item.description: If AI displaces human workers faster than the economy can reabsorb them, it risks eroding the very consumer demand firms depend on. We show that knowing this is not enough for firms to stop it. In a competitive task-based model of a transitioning economy, each firm ...

item.title: Pushing Crystals with Light That Is Never Absorbed
item.description: Mid-infrared light pushes tin selenide between crystal phases without being absorbed, using a dispersive optomechanical force.

item.title: How Two Fixed Determinants Exhaust the Fermi Sea
item.description: A single fixed Slater determinant acts as a universal antisymmetric backbone, while smooth symmetric waves carry the full physics of the fermionic sea.

item.title: Learning to Be Modular: Language Models Mirror the Mind
item.description: Artificial neural networks spontaneously develop specialized modules for different cognitive tasks, mirroring the human brain's functional division of labor.

item.title: Photons Playing Electrons: A Ten-Thousand-Mode Gauge Field
item.description: A silicon-nitride photonic lattice imprints a synthetic magnetic field on light, realizing the integer quantum Hall effect for photons across ten thousand modes.

item.title: Turning Classical Noise into Quantum Channels
item.description: Classical probability clouds cross a square-root bridge into Lindblad quantum channels, where decoherence replaces diffusion.

item.title: Finding the Bell Curve in Quantum States
item.description: Repeatedly mixing quantum states through a beam splitter washes out their differences, drawing them toward stabilizer states—the discrete bell curves of the quantum world.

item.title: UNICON: When Numbers Learn to Generalize
item.description: In UNICON, one frozen network learns predictive relationships from just a few numerical examples, then applies them to rivers, power grids, and web activity—without ever being retrained.

item.title: Reading the Integer: Thermal Hall Tomography in Graphene
item.description: Thermal Hall measurements directly read the topological Chern integer from chiral Majorana edge modes in rhombohedral graphene.

item.title: When Wave Chaos Learns to Optimize Itself
item.description: Chaotic microwave scattering becomes a self-optimizing physical neural network, using backward adjoint waves to tune outputs without a digital twin.

item.title: A Lone Qubit Learns Signals Exponentially Faster
item.description: A single superconducting qubit learns signal properties exponentially faster than conventional Gaussian sensors, using quantum coherence as a powerful sensing resource.

item.title: Learning a Liquid's Hidden Thermodynamic Map
item.description: A machine-learned functional reads symmetric density fields and maps them to a transferable thermodynamic description of liquids across temperatures and ensembles.

item.title: Solving Banach's Last Puzzle: A Century of Slices
item.description: A century-old conjecture is resolved by showing that a Banach space with all identical finite-dimensional slices must be a Hilbert space.

item.title: Proving the Amplituhedron's Tiles: A Cluster Algebra Breakthrough
item.description: A new proof shows BCFW recursion tiles the amplituhedron, with tile boundaries governed by compatible cluster variables, making a geometric conjecture rigorous for scattering amplitudes.

item.title: The Safety Constraint Hiding Outside the Data
item.description: In a model's training distribution, the safety boundary is a hole: nothing in the data marks where a sandbox escape begins, so the constraint must be verified from outside.

item.title: Turning AI Inward to Dissect Its Own Beliefs
item.description: An autonomous AI system turns interpretability methods on a language model, mapping its internal beliefs and steering its behavior from within.

item.title: Proving the Unprovable: Certifying AI’s Probabilistic Consistency
item.description: An interactive proof verifier spot-checks an AI's web of probabilistic predictions against a compact proof oracle, ensuring all its answers could come from one coherent worldview.

item.title: Making the Invisible Legible: A Symmetry That Recovers Blood Flow
item.description: By respecting the scale symmetry of pressure waveforms, physics-informed neural operators recover blood flow and vascular state from noninvasive signals.

item.title: Reading a Burnt Chip’s Memory: The Crash Data That Refused to Die
item.description: Floating-gate memory cells retain their charge pattern even after a chip's silicon is melted, allowing forensic recovery of crash data with a scanning electron microscope.

item.title: When Atoms Settle, Topology Awakens
item.description: Lattice relaxation in twisted semiconductor bilayers generates a pseudomagnetic field, awakening topological Chern bands from previously trivial flat bands.

item.title: When 'Stop' Doesn't Mean Stop: The Enforcement Gap in AI Agents
item.description: When an AI agent's approval gate pauses one branch, a concurrent sibling can still leak side effects; an external reference monitor re-establishes true stop.

item.title: When Excited States Refuse to Stay Still
item.description: Machine-learned maps redraw the shifting energy landscape as electrons and nuclei dance after light absorption.

item.title: Laying Down the Law: A Thermodynamic Ceiling for Plasmonic Solar Chemistry
item.description: A thermodynamic ceiling for plasmonic solar chemistry emerges from detailed balance, hot-carrier limits, and the single-geometry penalty of a nanoparticle handling the full solar spectrum.

item.title: Teaching Weakness to Speak: The Volume Revolution in Affinity
item.description: Tethering weak-binding proteins inside a tunable DNA nanocavity raises their effective concentration, making millimolar-affinity interactions measurable and allowing spatial design to override chemical preference.

item.title: The Echo at Beta's Quiet Edge: Hunting Sterile Neutrinos
item.description: A missing partner in beta decay—a sterile neutrino—leaves a spectral shift at the recoil endpoint, detectable by ultra-sensitive transition-edge sensors in cold silicon.
